result.edits:
Approved with four edits to /Users/wxy/Desktop/Partura/guidance/C03_r1.yaml. I re-ran `scripts/c03_check.py guidance` afterwards and it reports ADMISSIBLE (2 ideas, 14 priors, 24 seeds, exit 0).

(1) C2a seed 7 (the leg that tests whether the signal is just the intraday U shape): `sub(Volume, cross_delay(Volume, 5))` became `div(Volume, cross_mean(Volume, 30))`. Dividing each minute's volume by the 30-day mean for that same minute removes the stock's own volume shape multiplicatively. The old version subtracted a single day, so it was too noisy to settle fails_if(c), and subtraction still leaves (day level - 1) x U shape. The new version also pulls the call-auction minute's leverage down to about 1. If the 30-day mean is 0, today's volume is 0 too, so the result is NaN, which day_corr skips; it never produces inf. I confirmed the inner cross_mean keeps minute width after parsing.

(2) New prior C3P8b bans `{day_sum|day_mean}(Ret)`. Ret is always 0 in minute 0, so the intraday sum of minute returns is I. It has no price leaf, so C3P1 never touched it, and day_sum gets the x8 boost inside C2b.

(3) New prior C3P8c bans `sub(log(day_last/day_close(@price)), log(day_first/day_open(@price)))`. This closes the lead researcher's gap 1, which before was only down-weighted to 0.3.

(4) Two seeds added at the end of C2b: the 241-day versions of the intraday coefficient of variation (H5/v3) and of the kurtosis (H5/v7). The direct test shows residual-book turnover does not shrink as 1/sqrt(window). H6's coefficient of variation sits at 0.062-0.069 at every window from 15 to 241, because spike days jump in and out of the window. A long average of a per-day shape measure does not have that jump.

All other seeds, priors, roles and the assignment are unchanged; improve = 0/24. Checks: all 24 seeds keep a canonical form and repr identical to the written text, none is blocked by a prior, depths are 3-5, and skeletons are unique within each idea. The operator-weight fold is the same 20 names as before; the two new rules are not folded. In a 300-tree generation simulation, 0 returned trees are banned and 0 contain day_sum/mean(Ret). Mutations and crossovers ran 240 times on each idea and all were valid.

Seed provenance: 14 are the confirmed forms or their window / smoothing / aggregation neighbours, 4 of them identical to tested expressions. 5 are measure substitutions with a stated reason. 3 are falsification legs, and C2b now has 2 more slow versions. No correlation-rejected control, proxy family (H6), price-based family (H1/H2) or C01/C02 head family is carried in.

Wrote /Users/wxy/Desktop/Partura/research/coldstart_C03/beliefs_r1.md. I did not modify design_r1.md, any code, or the PLAN. I ran no servers, made no commits, and read no out-of-sample results or C03 group A material. Scratch scripts are in the session scratchpad.
